About the Team
OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their organization. The team comprises Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals who collaborate to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the Role

Our Government Sales team has a unique mission to help the U.S. Intelligence Community understand the transformative impact that highly capable AI models can bring to its most critical missions. This role combines technical understanding, strategic vision, relationship management, and value-driven sales strategy tailored specifically to Intelligence Community customers.

You’ll drive key opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pipeline generation through deployment and expansion. You’ll collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, solution strategists, and cross-functional partners to help Intelligence Community customers advance their missions through AI.

This role is based in Washington, D.C. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In addition, this role requires frequent on-site engagement at customer and partner facilities across the Washington, D.C./Northern Virginia corridor, including classified environments.

In this role, you will:

- Manage a focused set of key U.S. Intelligence Community accounts, developing and executing comprehensive account strategies.

- Lead Intelligence Community customers through their AI adoption journey, from initial consideration through successful deployment and expansion.

- Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, mission owners, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and other decision-makers across the Intelligence Community.

- Partner with Solutions and Research Engineering teams to design and execute complex customer programs and deployments.

- Develop and execute capture and co-sell strategies with federal systems integrators and specialized mission partners to position OpenAI in multi-year programs of record.

- Align opportunity planning and deal strategy to MIP and NIP funding cycles, classified contract vehicles, appropriations timing, and extended approval chains.

- Work with cleared technical teams to demonstrate value across cloud, hybrid, on-premises, and air-gapped environments and translate technical fit into mission outcomes.

- Own and manage an Intelligence Community consumption revenue target.

- Develop pipeline, lead complex deal strategies, and drive opportunities through the full sales cycle.

- Oversee revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and account reporting.

- Analyze account performance and provide actionable insights to internal and external stakeholders.

- Closely monitor Intelligence Community priorities, policies, acquisition trends, competitors, and partners to inform product roadmaps and company strategy.

- Navigate complex security, compliance, procurement, and contracting requirements associated with Intelligence Community customers.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions, Product, Engineering, Government Affairs, Marketing, Communications, Business Operations, People Operations, Finance, and Legal.

- Support the recruitment and onboarding of team members focused on the Intelligence Community.

- Help build and strengthen OpenAI’s culture and operating model within the Intelligence Community practice.

We're seeking someone with experience including:

- 10+ years selling commercial technology, including platform-as-a-service, software-as-a-service, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or other enterprise technology, to the U.S. Intelligence Community.

- A documented track record of closing high-value, multi-stakeholder enterprise technology deals across major Intelligence Community organizations and their supporting ecosystems.

- An active Top Secret clearance with Full Scope Polygraph.

- Developing and executing complex account and deal strategies within the Intelligence Community.

- Navigating Intelligence Community procurement, acquisition, contracting, security, and deployment processes.

- Deep familiarity with MIP and NIP funding cycles, classified contract vehicles, multi-year programs of record, and extended acquisition timelines.

- An established senior-level network of GS-15/SES/SIS and C-suite relationships across major Intelligence Community organizations and their supporting ecosystems.

- Experience partnering with federal systems integrators and specialized mission partners on capture strategies, co-selling, and program expansion.

- Proven experience selling cloud, cybersecurity, hybrid-cloud, or AI infrastructure into sensitive or classified environments, including on-premises and air-gapped deployment patterns.

- Consistently delivering growth in fast-paced, high-performance environments.

- Working directly with senior Intelligence Community executives, mission leaders, technical stakeholders, and decision-makers.

- Deep relationships and native familiarity with Intelligence Community missions, organizational structures, workflows, and buying processes.

- Translating technical capabilities into clear mission outcomes and strategic value.

- Communicating technical and strategic concepts clearly to both Intelligence Community customers and internal stakeholders.

- Leading high-visibility customer briefings, executive engagements, demonstrations, and industry events.

- Gathering, distilling, and applying detailed market intelligence, including agency priorities, policy developments, budget trends, acquisition strategies, and competitor activity.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand defense customers’ priorities and help them achieve their mission-critical objectives using AI. You build trusted relationships with senior executives and stakeholders across defense and national security agencies.

- Have a passion or deep curiosity about artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy OpenAI’s technology in ways that advance national security missions and benefit humanity. You’re enthusiastic about educating defense customers on AI capabilities and strategic implications.

- Are a builder. You enjoy impacting how our company grows its defense and intelligence business. You excel in establishing robust systems and processes tailored to defense customer requirements, executing them with precision and agility.

- Are excited by new challenges. You thrive when solving complex, mission-critical defense and national security problems. Bespoke challenges requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you, and you’re eager to experiment with innovative solutions within national security environments.

- Are a strategist. You deeply understand defense go-to-market best practices and proactively contribute to strategic initiatives. You plan years ahead, effectively aligning internal and external defense and intelligence stakeholders to achieve long-term objectives.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

ABOUT APPLY

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.

LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone).

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Project Manager at APPLY, you'll play a critical role in delivering exceptional digital solutions and fostering strong client relationships. Reporting into the Project Management team, you will lead complex projects spanning digital strategy, products, platforms, and marketing initiatives — driving excellence in project delivery while championing Agile methodologies and ensuring client satisfaction through effective communication and strategic problem-solving.
You bring a background from the digital agency or consultancy side, with proven experience delivering integrated digital experiences alongside a collaborative, team-oriented mindset. As a champion of project management best practices, you'll bring fluency in Agile while adapting, growing, and optimizing teams to apply the best methodologies for the right problems — driving flawless execution and delivery for your clients. You have your pulse on the day-to-day details but care about the big picture, and can move effortlessly between the two to drive transformation for your clients' businesses.
You are also, unapologetically, an AI-forward delivery leader. APPLY delivers through an agentic model in which human practitioners work alongside AI agents across the project lifecycle, and the Senior Project Manager is accountable for making that model work: setting the guardrails, owning the review gates, and keeping human judgment at the centre of everything that leaves our door. You are hungry for all things AI, you enjoy pulling apart your own processes to make them better, and you are energised rather than unsettled by how quickly this landscape moves.

Project & Program Management

•

Lead complex digital projects and programs from initiation to completion, managing scope, roadmaps, timelines, resourcing, and budgets across fixed-price and T&M agreements.

•

Translate client business outcomes into actionable project plans, roadmaps, and execution strategies.

•

Own core delivery artifacts end-to-end (SOWs, plans, resource trackers, status reports, risk/issue logs, and closure decks).

•

Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies and decisions escalating appropriately to senior stakeholders.

•

Adapt Agile, hybrid-Agile, or waterfall methodologies to match project needs and drive process efficiency.

•

Continuously streamline delivery workflows and status reporting using AI tools and smart automation.

•

Build and share reusable assets—prompts, templates, and best practices—to strengthen the Project Management discipline.

Agentic & AI-Enabled Delivery

•

Own delivery accountability and guardrails on agentic engagements, ensuring human review and approval for all AI-assisted outputs.

•

Scope and structure work effectively between AI agents and team members, maintaining clear review gates and risk logs.

•

Manage agentic failure modes (hallucinations, model drift, data dependencies, prompt quality) and maintain agent access/permission boundaries.

•

Align client expectations to an agentic operating model, emphasizing outcome-based metrics, transparent AI usage, and fast review cycles.

•

Report on outcome as well as activity — time to value, delivery velocity against a human-only baseline, and measurable value validation — not simply story counts and burn.

Client & Stakeholder Management

•

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing clear, concise, and proactive updates on progress, milestones, and scope changes.

•

Facilitate key workshops and client meetings (strategy sessions, UX reviews, demos) with clear agendas and actionable outcomes.

•

Navigate complex stakeholder discussions diplomatically, managing expectations and delivering difficult news early and constructively.

•

Partner with Client Services and account leadership to identify growth opportunities and ensure business value alignment.

•

Accurately discern stakeholder requirements and integrate them into planning and execution; actively manage client expectations, and delegate where appropriate rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

•

Maintain a healthy partnership with Client Services and support account growth activities, bringing commercial awareness to delivery conversations.

Team Leadership

•

Lead cross-functional teams (Strategy, Design, Engineering, QA, Data) using servant leadership to foster collaboration and high performance.

•

Guide, mentor, and coach Project Managers and Coordinators, proactively supporting their professional development.

•

Resolve team friction with empathy and candor, diffusing tension and focusing on solution-oriented outcomes.

•

Exemplify project management at APPLY, earning trust from both the project team and the leadership team.

Project Management Excellence

•

8+ years leading end-to-end digital solution delivery in consulting or agency environments for enterprise clients.

•

Proven ability to partner effectively with senior client leadership (Director, VP, C-suite).

•

Expertise in Agile and waterfall delivery frameworks, with the flexibility to select the right approach for each engagement.

•

Experience with modern digital ecosystems (Composable/Headless CMS, E-commerce, Loyalty, Personalization, Analytics).

•

Strong proficiency in industry-standard project management and collaboration tools including JIRA, Confluence, Notion, Instagantt, Smartsheet, and Google Suite.

•

Deep knowledge of the full software development lifecycle, CI/CD, and related delivery workflows across product, design, development, and QA.

•

Experience leading headless implementations across platforms such as e-commerce (CommerceTools, BigCommerce), CMS (Contentful, Contentstack), Loyalty (Talon.one, EagleEye), Identity (Stytch, Okta, Auth0), and Personalization (Ninetailed, Segment).

•

Knowledge of technical concepts including AI, machine learning, data analytics, cloud computing, and platform integrations.

•

Demonstrable critical thinking, creative problem-solving, and willingness to tackle complex challenges.

•

A can-do attitude, passion for digital products, and resilience to work in a flexible, fast-paced environment.

Communication & Soft Skills

•

Communication Excellence: You possess impeccable written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively bridge the gap between executive summaries and technical detail, provide proactive updates, and communicate complex or difficult news with transparency and clarity.

•

Interpersonal Intelligence: You demonstrate high emotional intelligence, reading rooms effectively and navigating conflict with empathy. You practice compassionate candor, resolving tensions by focusing on solutions, and can influence stakeholders without formal authority.

•

Leadership & Mindset: You are customer-centric, taking full accountability for project outcomes rather than just tasks. You lead with a coaching instinct, fostering growth in those around you, and maintain the resilience and adaptability required to thrive in a fast-changing, AI-driven environment.

AI & Agentic Delivery

As APPLY operates on an agentic model, hands-on AI fluency is essential. You will use these tools daily and comfortably engage in technical discussions around agentic workflows.

Required:

•

Hands-on experience using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and AI workflows to accelerate planning, documentation, and reporting, with a drive to continuously adapt as tools evolve.

•

Proven critical evaluation skills to review and refine AI outputs for accuracy, quality, and strategic alignment before client delivery.

•

A genuine hunger for all things AI and a commitment to keep growing with a field that changes month to month. You experiment, you share what you learn, and you expect the way you work in twelve months to look different from today.

Strong bonus

•

Direct experience leading agentic delivery—structuring ceremonies where AI drafts and humans decide, introducing AI workflows to clients, and managing the associated change.

•

Familiarity with BMAD methodology, Markdown, CLI-based AI tools (e.g., Claude Code), and MCP connectors.

•

Track record of building reusable AI skills, agents, or automations adopted by other team members.

•

Relevant AI certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Gemini Enterprise Certified Partner Specialist, Anthropic Academy).

Nice to Have

•

Experience working in Commerce and/or Loyalty programs.

•

Technical background in Computer Science.

•

PMP, Agile, or Scrum Master certification.

•

Experience delivering AI or agentic products for clients, not only using AI to deliver traditional products.

•

You have delivered at least two medium-to-large projects of each engagement type — Upstream, Midstream, and Downstream — from kickoff through closure.

•

Your clients would describe the experience as transparent, well-run, and better than what they have had elsewhere.

•

Your engagements demonstrate measurable value against an agreed baseline, not just completed activity.

•

Something you built, improved, or documented is being used by PjMs beyond your own project.

Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About the role

We’re hiring a Support Operations Systems Lead to help own the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that keep User Operations running reliably at scale.

This is a hands-on technical support operations role for someone who can move fluidly between live triage of our projects, backlog management of internal requests, systems health, stakeholder communication, and end-to-end program ownership. You’ll work across ticketing workflows, routing logic, queue health, labeling taxonomy, escalation paths, workforce signals, and internal tooling requests.

The ideal person is more technical than a traditional operations lead, more hands-on than a traditional TPM, and less software-engineering-heavy than a dedicated SWE. You should be comfortable investigating messy operational issues, making or coordinating safe system changes, pushing back on unclear requests, and turning recurring problems into durable improvements.

What you’ll do

- Own day-to-day operations for core support systems, including ticketing workflows, routing, queues, labels, taxonomy, escalations, and related tooling.

- Triage urgent operational issues as they arise, especially when system behavior, workforce distribution, queue health, or SLA risk looks off.

- Manage intake, prioritization, and follow-through for systems requests from support managers, TSEs, operations leads, engineering, product, and other internal teams.

- Help maintain the team’s roadmap by distinguishing one-off fixes from broader system improvements, surfacing recurring pain points, and pushing back on low-leverage work.

- Drive smaller technical and operational programs end-to-end, being responsible for discovery, scoping and execution, rollout, documentation and success metrics.

- Partner with engineering, data, IT, and support leaders to debug issues, validate changes, improve monitoring, and prevent repeat failures.

- Use Cursor and AI-native workflows to reduce manual toil, investigate issues, summarize signals, draft documentation, test changes, and improve how the team operates.

You may be a fit if

- You have experience in support operations, systems operations, technical program management, or a similarly cross-functional technical systems role.

- You are comfortable working close to operational systems such as ticketing platforms, routing workflows, queue configuration, labels/taxonomies, dashboards, Slack workflows, and internal tools.

- You are technical enough to investigate system issues, read configuration or code, and partner effectively with engineers, even if you are not primarily a software engineer.

- You are excellent at triage and prioritization: when several things are broken or ambiguous, you can quickly determine what is urgent, what needs investigation, what needs escalation, and what should become a longer-term fix.

- You can own work end to end: clarify the problem, align stakeholders, sequence the work, communicate tradeoffs, launch safely, and measure whether the change worked.

- You are comfortable pushing back thoughtfully and can tell stakeholders “not yet,” “not this way,” or “this should be part of a broader fix” while maintaining trust.

- You are energized by a role that blends firefighting with systems-building, and you have a strong bias toward action, clarity, and continuous improvement.
